notes.title: Update to 1.0.5
notes.content:
General Fixes
 - Engine upgrade to latest version resulted in numerous background fixes. 
 - Fixed issue where crates would sometimes retain references to water puddles even after being moved away from the puddle. 
 - Fixed a bug where death interface could be active but invisible, locking the game from interaction. 
 - Fixed a bug where over-healing was being counted in future health calculations, resulting in extra unintended healing in some cases. 
 - Fixed issue where changing the cursor style from the options while in game would not persist. 
 - Fixed issue where objects could become permanently stuck to tractor-beams by teleporting them in the right way.
 - Improved interactions between multiple entities and small colliders. 

Chapter 1
 - Fixed issue where tutorial was not being properly triggered the first time ELON is damaged.  

Chapter 2
 - Papers in the conference room now have more varied inspect dialog as intended. 

Chapter 5

Chapter 6

Chapter 7 
 - Replaced a puzzle which was too tightly balanced and resulted in frustrating behavior.

notes.title: 0.9.10 (May 2, 2024)
notes.content:
General Fixes: 
- Users will now be warned when starting the game if a connection to Steam can not be made. 
- Updated laser levels to include an indicator when large drones are off-screen. 
- Reduced difficulty in casual by forcing  health to be at least 5 when staring a level or restarting a checkpoint.
- Level timer now turns grey when current time exceeds best recorded time. 
- Using arrow keys to move the camera will now properly limit camera speed. 
- Fixed issue where smoke from explosions would improperly collide with some layers.
- Added button to join discord from main menu. 
- Fixed issue where island background was not displaying properly.
- Viewing tutorials in non-driving levels now looks cleaner.

Chapter 2: 
- Added puzzle elements to demonstrate that power supplies are not destroyed by fire.

Chapter 3: 
- Tweaked navigation parameters to prevent Robits from getting stuck when pathing towards attracts which they ought to be able to reach.
- Alarm sounds now turn off at the completion of a level. 
- Fixed issue where Robits could unintentionally move magnets in certain situations.

Chapter 5: 
- Fixed issue where ELON could sometimes not be damaged by lasers.

Chapter 6:
- The opening cut scene is now pausable.
- Fixed issue where tutorial could display even after leaving the level. 
- Fixed issue where hint keybindings were not being updated in production code. 
- Added hint to show the player how to resize the dialog box without a mouse. 
- Added hint to show the player how to walk. 

Known Issues: 
- Color shifts do not properly apply to all attract elements in the game. 
- It may occasionally be impossible to turn the wiper puzzle on.

notes.content:
General Fixes: 
- Difficulty options dropdown is now shown in a disabled state for non-game interactions. This is to make it more clear that difficulty exists but can not be set without the context of a particular save slot.
- VSync option added to graphics settings in the options menu.
- Sentry projectile speed now scales with difficulty (Hard is ~2x as fast). 
- Out of control Roambas speed now scales with difficulty.
- Starting battery time should now be properly set with difficulty at the beginning of driving levels.
- Dialog boxes have been resized to prevent text overflowing visible bounds in some cases. 
- Fixed rendering issue where player could unintentionally render on top of parts of a timer. 
- Fixed issue that was causing a fight for camera control when an invisible mouse cursor was near the edge of the screen with edge scrolling enabled. 
- Fixed issue where cursor could highlight gameobjects when after closing the pause menu when a cursor was not allowed. 
- Fixed issue where dialog portrait names were sometimes not displaying properly. 


Chapter 5: 
 - Improved interaction between tractor beams and crates at the entrance of the research facility. 

Known Issues: 
- Color shifts do not properly apply to all attract elements in the game. 
- It may occasionally be impossible to turn the wiper puzzle on.

Chapter 3: (Bottom)
 - Improved wire layout so they could not be unintentionally bridged. 
 - Fixed Robit which attempted to spawn Robits in the wrong direction.
 - Cleaned up some errors that may have resulted in unexpected timer behavior.

 - Fixed issue where ELON's world position would be incorrectly set even though his rendered position was correct. 
 - Convinced some puddles that they were not in fact ice and should be electrified. 
 - The first room will now reset to a more complete state when loading last checkpoint from the second room. 
 - A lava lamp has been placed at the transition between the first and second rooms. ELON is attracted to this lava lamp which will give the player additional time to stop him from  running all the way back to the first room.  

Driving: 
 - Damage cracks should now clear after choosing to replay a leven from the level complete dialog.
